subject: Secure release traceability & secrets stewardship — artifact handover
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@northbridge.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security_assessor@northbridge.com
Date: 2026-04-01 09:12 PST
Subject: Request: secure release traceability & secrets stewardship artifacts

Kimberly —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As part of our SIG intake for the upcoming assessment, the assessor team needs a compact bundle demonstrating the release traceability and secrets stewardship practices for the past quarter. Specifically we require: 

- A short mapping that ties production releases to PRs and CI runs for the last three deploys (timestamped).
- Code review evidence (PR links, review notes) showing reviewer + approvals for those releases.
- CI/CD controls: build logs that show signed artifacts / immutable build ids and the gating policy (who can merge).
- Secrets management proof: key rotation records, KMS/HSM usage notes, and an inventory of secrets with owners and TTL.
- Change management: CR references, who approved, and rollback/runbook excerpts.

Can you provide a bundle by EOD next Tuesday (2026-04-06)? If parts need to be redacted for customer data, note what was removed and why. The assessor prefers a single zipped bundle and a short index sheet.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Security Assessor — Northbridge

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@northbridge.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-01 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Request: secure release traceability & secrets stewardship artifacts

Emily —

Acknowledged. I'm assigning this internally to Dev and Marissa to assemble the bundle and produce the index sheet. Plan: collect PR + CI links, export the minimal CI run logs (scrubbed), attach code review notes, and include keystore rotation records. Jonas will validate any KMS/HSM references before we hand over.

We'll use a Drive folder and provide a single ZIP via secure link. Expect a draft by 2026-04-03 for an internal review and the final bundle by EOD 2026-04-06. If you have a preferred filename pattern or template for the index sheet, send it over; otherwise we'll use our standard "sdlc-artifact-index.xlsx" and note redactions inline.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-03 08:27 PST
Subject: Draft bundle: release traceability + artifacts (internal)

Team —

I'm attaching the first pass of artifacts to the Drive folder and attaching key files inline. Highlights below: 

1) Releases covered: release-2026-03-18, release-2026-03-29, release-2026-03-31. Each folder contains: PR list, merged commit SHAs, and CI run ids.
2) Code review evidence: PR-312, PR-346, PR-357. See "pr-357-review-notes.pdf" for reviewer comments and approval timestamps. PR links: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/312 , /pull/346 , /pull/357.
3) CI/CD controls: exported minimal logs in "ci-run-logs-20260331.txt" showing build id, artifact checksum, and the merge gate policy (two reviewers required; automated lint + test gating).
4) Secrets management: included "keystore-rotation-records.csv" (rotation date, key id, rotating engineer). KMS key reference: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/rlk-prod-v1 (we will redact the actual key material).
5) Change management: CR-842 is the change request for 2026-03-31 deploy. Patch is attached as "change-request-CR-842.patch" and the Jira ticket: JIRA-CR-842.

Attachments (uploaded, not all attached inline to external): pr-357-review-notes.pdf, ci-run-logs-20260331.txt, keystore-rotation-records.csv, change-request-CR-842.patch, sdlc-artifact-index.xlsx

Notes on redactions: logs have customer request IDs removed and IP addresses redacted. I added a short "redaction_notes.txt" in the Drive folder.

Let me know any gaps and I'll iterate quickly.

- Dev

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-04 11:15 PST
Subject: Re: Draft bundle: release traceability + artifacts (internal)

Thanks, Dev — good first pass. A couple of items I want validated before external handoff: 

- HSM/KMS evidence: please replace the bare key path with proof of HSM-backed usage (audit event ids) or a statement from our KMS that the key is non-exportable. The assessor asked specifically for an indication that private key material was never accessible in plaintext.
- Keystore rotation CSV: add the KMS key version ids and the rationale column for rotation (compromise vs routine).
- PR approvals: add one snippet that shows the "approver" email + timestamp in the PR UI export (screenshot ok) for each release.

Also, redaction checklist: include who redacted which fields and a short justification. We should not block on this, but flag it in the index sheet so the assessor knows what was removed.

I'll review the final bundle once you add the above.

Jonas Weber
Director, Applied Security
